name: inline-images
description: Gives Claude a show_image tool and shows pasted images and images Claude reads inline in the terminal transcript

showPastedImages.title: Show pasted images
showPastedImages.description: Draw the images you paste into the prompt inline in the transcript

showReadImages.title: Show images Claude reads
showReadImages.description: Draw the images Claude opens with Read inline in the transcript

showCopyButton.title: Show a copy button
showCopyButton.description: Draw a button under each image that copies the image to the clipboard

showOpenButton.title: Show an open button
showOpenButton.description: Draw a button under each image that opens the image in the default image viewer

defaultColumns.title: Default width of show_image
defaultColumns.description: Width in terminal columns of an image show_image draws when Claude gives no width
